from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """One extracted cash balance line item from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant/company name found in the document")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of statement (e.g. 'Balance Sheet', 'Statement of Cash Flows')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item as written")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date associated with the balance (e.g. 'December 31, 2023' or 'March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
